title: Trump ready to double down on Russian sanctions: US' Ukraine envoy Keith Kellogg
description: President Trump is prepared to double down on US sanctions for Russia to bring about an end to its war on Ukraine, retired Gen. Keith Kellogg, his special envoy to the conflict, exclusively told The Post this week.

title: Trump's Justice Department ends Biden-era task force aimed at seizing assets of Russian oligarchs
description: The Trump administration's Justice Department has disbanded a Biden-era program aimed at seizing the assets of Russian oligarchs as a means to punish Russia for its invasion of Ukraine.

title: How Remote Control Kamikaze Cars Are Helping Ukrainian Soliders
description: Ukraine's military is using kamikaze remote control car technology to spare soldiers in the retaliation against Russia. Here's how.

title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Ukraine 'launches counterattack in Russian region' | War latest
description: Russian forces have repelled a new Ukrainian counterattack in the Kursk region, Moscow has said. Elsewhere, a Russian politician has suggested that Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin could meet as soon as this month. Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Ukraine mourns Belarusian activist who took her fight with Russia to the front lines
description: Maria Zaitseva, who was widely viewed as a heroine of the democracy movement in Belarus, was killed in action on Jan. 17 near the eastern Ukrainian city of Pokrovsk one day after turning 24

title: Kyiv says drones hit Russian airfield
description: Ukrainian forces struck an airfield in southern Russia that was being used to launch Iran-designed Shahed drones, Ukraine’s General Staff claimed Thursday. France meanwhile said it had delivered the first batch of Mirage fighter jets to Ukraine and the Netherlands sent more F-16s.

title: US Spy Plane Buzzes Russia's Black Sea Red Line as Trump Takes Charge
description: An American intelligence-gathering aircraft has operated off the coast of Crimea for the first time since the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine war.

title: U.S. Policy Crucial for Ukraine Conflict Resolution, Russia Awaits Action
description: Russia has noted the United States must establish a clear policy on the Ukraine conflict, as Moscow will respond based on U.S. actions. Russia's Foreign Ministry voiced the need for clarity in the U.S.’s approach to ending the war, with potential talks between Putin and Trump at an advanced stage.

title: Ukraine Launches Renewed Kursk Offensive: Reports
description: Russia's defense ministry said Ukraine's military launched a new offensive in the Russian region.

title: Has Trump readied his Russia-Ukraine peace plan?
description: Donald Trump’s special peace envoy for Ukraine Keith Kellogg will reportedly present the US administration’s peace plan at a security conference in Germany next week. The former military general confirmed Wednesday he would be attending the event
